exceptions.reason: The return type widens from a readonly tuple to the same mutable tuple. A mutable tuple is assignable everywhere the readonly one was, so every existing caller still compiles; the change only lets the documented call satisfy @lit-labs/ssr's mutable RenderInfo.elementRenderers.
